verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere has user accounts and a hosted cloud (Wally Cloud), so a data-export-and-leave story is a fair question for it. The evidence documents on-device processing (data stays on the phone) and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Neither is an export capability; both are adjacent features. Nothing in the pack describes exporting account data or history in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
